sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We deeply value our long-standing relationship and are pleased to accommodate your request for a 24-month contract starting 1 February 2027. By maintaining our standard 30-day payment terms, we are able to reduce our price to €51.50 per unit. 

Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us. For our planning, this Angebot stands with a price of €51.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 February 2027. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €51.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We therefore propose a revised price of €50.90 per unit, maintaining the 30-day payment term and 24-month contract starting 1 February 2027. As an alternative, we can offer a price of €50.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 February 2027.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
